title: Feeling Sentence Builder
description: Students practice communicating a feeling in a healthy way by assembling an "I feel ___ because ___" sentence from word/picture tiles for a given scenario.
creator: Health Education
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Health Education

learningObjectives: Students practice communicating a feeling in a healthy way by assembling an "I feel ___ because ___" sentence from word/picture tiles for a given scenario.

pedagogical.instructionalRationale: Supports a Apply-level objective through direct interaction rather than passive reading.
